title: 1RB1LC_1RC0RF_1RD0LB_1RE0LD_1LF---_0RA1LA: every level runs the same orbit of one digit map, in Lean
text: On a long tail the proved table is the map f(10a + d) = 31a + K[d/2] on one number, and every level runs a prefix of the orbit of 22. Lean proves the machine halts exactly when the walk halts where that orbit runs out of the 772-digit budget of level 2, about 2·10<sup>770</sup> steps along; no closed form is known. Measured on the real orbit, a level-2 end is a proved loop 60% of the time and a halt 5%.
